question: Which one-line summary matches the lesson 'Speculative Decoding — Draft, Verify, Repeat'?
options: Training is parallel and FLOP-bound. Inference is serial and memory-bound. Different bottleneck, different tricks.

Autoregressive decoding is serial. Each token waits for the previous one. Speculative decoding breaks the chain: a cheap model drafts N tokens, the expensive model verifies all N in one forward pass. When the draft is right you paid one big forward for N generations.
BERT sees both sides. GPT sees only the past. The triangle mask is the most consequential single line of code in modern AI.
One attention head learns one relation at a time. Eight heads learn eight. Heads are free. Take more of them.
